cards.name: Garruk's Lost Wolf // Hey, Has Anyone Seen Garruk?
cards.oracleText:
When Garruk's Lost Wolf enters the battlefield, create a Huntsman Role token attached to another target creature you control. (Enchanted creature gets +1/+1 and has "{T}: Add {G}")
Mill the top four cards of your library. Return a creature or planeswalker card milled this way to your hand.
